findings.source_quote: πάντα τὰ λεγόμενα αὐτοῖς τάχιον νοοῦσι καὶ συνίουσιν, ὅτι ἔχουσι τὸν φόβον τοῦ Κυρίου ἐν ἑαυτοῖς· ὅπου γὰρ ὁ Κύριος κατοικεῖ, ἐκεῖ καὶ σύνεσις πολλή.
findings.english_quote: understand and comprehend everything said to them more quickly.[i] They have the fear of the Lord within them. Where the Lord dwells, there is much understanding.
findings.issue: The simplified text retains the individual assertions but drops their explicit explanatory relationships. The source's ὅτι identifies inward fear of the Lord as the reason for their quicker understanding, and γὰρ introduces the supporting explanation about the Lord's dwelling. Separate unconnected statements leave these relationships implicit.
findings.suggested_revision: A candidate for fresh review is: “understand and comprehend everything said to them more quickly,[i] because they have the fear of the Lord within them. For where the Lord dwells, there is much understanding.”

findings.source_quote: Ἆρον ἀπὸ σεαυτοῦ, φησί, τὴν λύπην· καὶ γὰρ αὕτη ἀδελφή ἐστι τῆς διψυχίας καὶ τῆς ὀξυχολίας.
findings.english_quote: Retain all historical paragraphs, dialogue, negation, Spirit/salvation tension, warnings, prayer/altar imagery and final conditions. Shared notes disclose working and versional alternatives.
findings.issue: The simplification metadata claims retention of prayer/altar imagery and final conditions, but the supplied section contains no prayer or altar imagery and ends with an imperative and promise, not stated final conditions. This misdescribes the scope of the supplied source and the adaptation.
findings.suggested_revision: Replace this metadata with a section-specific account of the material actually retained. A candidate for fresh review is: “Retain all six paragraphs, dialogue, negations, the sorrow/Spirit/salvation tension, the vineyard comparison, and the concluding imperative and promise. Shared notes disclose working and versional alternatives.”

summary: Both editions were independently compared with all six paragraphs of the selected working Greek. The standard edition preserves the clauses, speakers, negations, comparisons, and difficult wearing-away/saving assertion without adding doctrinal conditions. The simplified edition likewise preserves the substantive teaching but needs explicit causal connections restored in paragraph 6 and inaccurate scope metadata corrected. Both follow the reader-facing servant policy; no repentance term occurs in this section. The disclosed working readings were not replaced merely because alternatives were reported, and the bracketed conjunction is identified as editorial. Acceptance here concerns fidelity to the supplied working source and disclosure, not verification of the cited external editions, plates, apparatus, handwriting, or an exhaustive collation. Proposed corrections remain subject to fresh review.
